source_snapshot.items: AMD GPU RAS tool version check
source_snapshot.procedure: Verify recipe, preserve logs, download/install the latest approved AMD GPU RAS Tool on the OS using the Ubuntu dpkg example, run `sudo amdgpuras -v`, then collect results and unexpected logs.
source_snapshot.criteria: The reported tool version is equal to or newer than1.6.3.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES and read-only version query, but it overlooks that the source first downloads and installs a package and changes `-v` to `--version` without proving alias support.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: RPUC/CHANGED with LOW risk because the query is automatable but package provenance, compatibility, installation and rollback require approval.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Correctly identifies the semantic version threshold but incorrectly calls the complete testcase read-only despite the required package installation.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Separates the owner-approved package transition from the automatable installed-version query and comparison.
historical_reviews.related_cases: Adjacent GPU RAS cases inject faults; this case establishes only tool-package eligibility and must not execute any injection.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Record existing package/tool state, verify the supplied artifact signature/hash and OS/architecture/driver compatibility, install only if approved, run the source `-v` form, parse semantic version numerically and preserve exact evidence.

original_test_intent: Confirm the AMD GPU RAS tool installed on the SUT is an approved build whose reported version is at least1.6.3 before RAS testing.
original_method: Capture SUT OS/architecture, driver and current amdgpuras/package state; obtain the approved package artifact and expected hash/signature; install it only under the project change/rollback policy if needed; run `sudo amdgpuras -v` and optionally the documented equivalent only after proving support; preserve raw stdout/stderr and exit code; parse the numeric version including suffix policy; require version >=1.6.3; verify package/driver health and unexpected logs without injecting any fault.
manual_activity: Package/platform owner supplies and approves the exact AMDGPU-RAS artifact, compatibility and rollback; agent may install through the approved method, query the version and compare it to1.6.3.
required_inputs: Target OS release/architecture, GPU driver compatibility and current package/tool state
Approved AMDGPU-RAS package name/version/source/hash/signature and repository or artifact path
Whether source `-v` and proposed `--version` are supported equivalents for this build
Installation privilege, maintenance window and approved rollback command/artifact
safety_requirements: Do not download or install an unspecified `latest` or wildcard-matched artifact
Preserve current package/tool/driver state before changes
Do not clear logs or run RAS injection for this version-only case
Stop on signature/hash, OS/architecture, dependency or driver incompatibility
Rollback only through the approved package procedure and verify OS/driver health
agent_execution_scope: Verify supplied artifact identity and perform approved install if authorized
Run the version query, parse/compare and collect package/log evidence
Do not select an artifact source, override dependencies, inject faults, define suffix policy or issue DUT verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The proposed remote `amdgpuras --version` is suitable only after proving this build supports that option; it omits the source's approved installation prerequisite and uses insecure password/host-key handling.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Prefer the source `sudo amdgpuras -v`; capture binary path, package metadata, stdout/stderr and exit code, then compare parsed version components to1.6.3. Use project SSH credentials/host-key policy, not inline passwords.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Ubuntu22.04 dpkg example, source `-v`, minimum1.6.3, Common branch and30/15 minutes are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Treat package installation as a controlled prerequisite and the installed binary query/comparison as the automated test step.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds artifact provenance, existing-state/rollback, option support, semantic parsing and compatibility evidence.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A package filename or `latest` label cannot prove the executing binary version; raw output and resolved binary/package identity are required.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Installing a mismatched build can break tool/driver compatibility even though the version query itself is read-only.

project_override_considerations: Do not reinterpret `latest` as permission for internet retrieval. The project must nominate the artifact. Pre-release/vendor suffix ordering against1.6.3 must be explicit; lexical string comparison is invalid.
expected_evidence: OS release/architecture, GPU driver and pre-install package/binary state
Approved package artifact source, filename, version, hash/signature and install transcript if changed
Resolved binary path and exact `amdgpuras -v` stdout/stderr/exit code
Parsed semantic version and explicit numeric comparison to1.6.3
Post-install package/driver/tool health, unexpected-log check and rollback status

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and criterion consistently require an AMDGPU-RAS version check with minimum1.6.3. `latest` is underspecified package selection, not contradictory intent.

blocked_analysis.analysis: An approved package and policy can be supplied; the version query and threshold are fully defined once installed.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Reliability row189 Wistron-GPU RAS-00834-V005: approve target OS/architecture/driver and current-tool baseline, exact AMDGPU-RAS package version/source/hash/signature plus install/rollback policy; confirm whether `-v` and `--version` are equivalent for the approved build and define semantic/pre-release suffix comparison against minimum1.6.3.

review_improvement: Corrects the earlier read-only characterization by isolating the controlled package mutation from the simple version query and makes the threshold comparison reproducible.
independent_technical_reasoning: The test result must come from the binary that will run later RAS cases, not from an artifact filename or package metadata alone. Installation changes SUT state and can alter dependencies, so provenance, compatibility and rollback precede automation. Version components must be compared numerically because lexical ordering misorders values such as1.10 and1.6. Vendor/pre-release suffixes need an owner rule. No error injection is necessary to prove tool eligibility.
